ideas.title: Investigation into Minneapolis Police Department's Handling of Misconduct Allegations
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Minneapolis Police Department's handling of misconduct allegations, including the resignation of Police Chief Brian O'Hara.
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding Police Chief Brian O'Hara's resignation?
How does this incident reflect on the Minneapolis Police Department's handling of misconduct allegations?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it highlights the need for increased transparency and accountability within law enforcement agencies.

ideas.title: Federal Crackdown on Healthcare Fraud in California
ideas.description: This story would investigate the federal crackdown on healthcare fraud in California, including the freeze of billions of dollars in healthcare funds.
questions: What were the findings of the federal investigation into healthcare funds in California?
How does this incident reflect on the need for increased regulation in the healthcare industry?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it highlights the need for increased scrutiny and regulation in the healthcare industry to prevent large-scale fraud schemes.
